mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, it is 67 degrees with clear skies by Verona City Hall. We are currently under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS is passing overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 56 degrees with rain expected.

The city has posted a comprehensive list of engineering services reports provided to the City Council. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather community feedback on new design concepts.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, check out ART House 360 or trivia at Hop Haus, followed by live music and the Main Street Trick or Treat event this Thursday.
In a recent report, officers assisted with two separate cardiac arrest calls on October 21 where life-saving measures were taken and patients were transported to the hospital.
Today's flavor is the decadent Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still time to stop in for a treat.
